source.english_context: Unit 11 School, Children, and Family Life Goal: talk with teachers, understand school papers, and help children join daily routines. Daily Life English My child was absent yesterday. Can I meet with the teacher? What time is drop-off? Do I need to sign this permission slip? How do I enroll my child? Which documents does the school need? Is there an after-school program? Where does the school bus stop? How can I see my child's homework? My child needs help understanding the instructions. Can you send this information by email? Is an interpreter available for our meeting? Who should I call if we will be late? How do I report a food allergy? What supplies should my child bring? Vocabulary attendance being present at school absent not at school or work permission slip a paper a parent signs to allow something drop-off the time or place a child arrives pick-up the time or place a child leaves parent-teacher conference a meeting between family and teacher enrollment the process of registering for a school or program homework schoolwork students do outside class report card a record of a student's school progress after-school program organized activities after regular classes end school supplies items such as notebooks and pencils used at school field trip a school visit to a place outside the classroom US Customs Schools expect regular attendance and messages when a child is absent. Teachers often use email, apps, or paper forms to contact families. Ask for language help if school papers are difficult. Dialogue Parent: My child was sick yesterday. School Office: Thank you for calling. What is your child's name? Parent: Her name is Hana Sato. School Office: Please send a note when she returns. Parent: Okay. Thank you.

japanese_explanation.heading: 学校とは早めに連絡する
points: 子どもが休む時は学校に連絡するのが普通です。理由を短く伝えれば大丈夫です。
学校からのメール、アプリ、プリントは大切です。遠足や医療、写真などは保護者の署名が必要なことがあります。
分からない時は、先生や事務室に説明や言語サポートを頼んでください。

existing_simplified_chinese.heading: 要主动和学校联系
points: 孩子缺席时，通常需要通知学校。简单说明原因就可以。
学校邮件、App消息和纸质通知都很重要。郊游、医疗或拍照等活动可能需要家长签字。
不懂时，可以请老师或办公室解释，也可以要求语言帮助。

ko.heading: 학교와 조기에 연락하기
points: 자녀가 결석할 경우 학교에 연락하는 것이 일반적입니다. 간단하게 이유를 설명해도 괜찮습니다.
학교에서 오는 이메일, 앱 메시지, 인쇄물은 중요합니다. 현장 학습, 의료 관련 사항, 사진 촬영 등에는 학부모의 서명이 필요할 수 있습니다.
이해하기 어려운 경우, 선생님이나 교무실에 설명을 요청하거나 언어 지원을 부탁하세요.

zh-Hans.heading: 要主动和学校联系
points: 孩子缺席时，通常需要通知学校。简单说明原因即可。
学校邮件、应用程序消息和纸质通知都很重要。郊游、医疗或拍照等活动可能需要家长签字。
不懂时，可以请老师或办公室解释，也可以要求语言帮助。

es.heading: Comuníquese con la escuela con antelación
points: Es normal contactar a la escuela cuando un niño va a faltar. No es necesario dar muchos detalles, una breve explicación es suficiente.
Los correos electrónicos, aplicaciones y documentos impresos de la escuela son importantes. Es posible que se necesite la firma de los padres para excursiones, asuntos médicos o fotografías.
Si algo no lo entiende, pida una explicación o soporte lingüístico al maestro o a la oficina de la escuela.

pt-BR.heading: Entre em contato com a escola antecipadamente
points: É comum avisar a escola quando uma criança vai faltar. Basta informar o motivo brevemente.
E-mails, aplicativos e comunicados impressos da escola são importantes. Passeios, questões médicas ou fotos podem exigir a assinatura dos pais.
Se não entender algo, peça uma explicação ou suporte de idioma ao professor ou à secretaria.

fr.heading: Communiquez tôt avec l'école
points: Il est courant de contacter l'école lorsque votre enfant s'absente. Une brève explication de la raison est suffisante.
Les e-mails, les applications et les documents imprimés de l'école sont importants. Les sorties scolaires, les soins médicaux ou les photos peuvent nécessiter la signature des parents.
Si vous ne comprenez pas, demandez une explication ou un soutien linguistique à l'enseignant ou au bureau de l'école.

de.heading: Sprechen Sie frühzeitig mit der Schule
points: Es ist üblich, die Schule zu informieren, wenn Ihr Kind fehlt. Eine kurze Begründung ist ausreichend.
E-Mails, Apps und gedruckte Mitteilungen der Schule sind wichtig. Für Ausflüge, medizinische Belange oder Fotos kann die Unterschrift der Eltern erforderlich sein.
Wenn Sie etwas nicht verstehen, bitten Sie den Lehrer oder das Sekretariat um eine Erklärung oder sprachliche Unterstützung.
